resolutions.researcher_notes: current_ref confirmed dead: news.bjx.com.cn returns an Aliyun WAF slider-CAPTCHA challenge page (verified via url_verifier.py -- 200 but token missing; also confirmed via curl with a full desktop UA, same WAF JS payload). archive.org has NO snapshot of this exact URL (wayback/available returns empty archived_snapshots as of 2026-07-29). Traced the underlying real document: the bjx article republishes 广西发改委 桂发改电力〔2021〕184号 《广西"能源网"建设2021年工作推进方案》 (2021-03-15, published 2021-03-23) -- confirmed via an archive.org snapshot of the DRC's own page (http://web.archive.org/web/20210801050232/http://fgw.gxzf.gov.cn/zwgk/wjzx/zyzc/t8348400.shtml), which lists five attachments including 附件5.2021年"能源网"大会战项目-油气管网项目推进计划.xlsx (the itemized oil/gas pipeline project list, 31 projects per the plan text). That xlsx attachment itself has NO wayback snapshot, and the live fgw.gxzf.gov.cn origin is geo-blocked (ConnectTimeout, confirmed), so the itemized 31-project list -- which would show whether 'Teng County' is on it -- cannot be read. A full-text reproduction of the plan on a solar-industry news site (kesolar.com, fetched and verified live) names the specific 2021 gas-pipeline work items narratively: 广西LNG外输管道桂林支线, 新疆煤制气外输管道广西支干线工程, 钦南柳管道-茂昆线成品油管道联通工程, "县县通"天然气工程建设, 北海LNG接收站二/三期 -- none of these name 藤县 (Teng County). Ran multiple Bing searches via curl (WebSearch tool quota was exhausted at 200/200 this session, same limit the prior deep-sweep researcher hit) for 藤县+天然气/支线/输气管道/天然气管网/立项/核准 in various combinations: zero pipeline-related results: returned only unrelated Teng County tourism/government/business-registry pages. Cannot confirm the recorded Status='proposed' (or any status) for a Teng County gas branch from any accessible source. This reinforces the existing rows/P7663.json existence concern rather than resolving it -- recommend the same manual/browser-based re-check of the bjx page or the un-archived xlsx attachment before deciding to keep this row.
